answer: Standing is minted only by witnessed continuity: each completed task is counter-signed by the stranger it served, and a fresh key stays mute until unrelated parties have dealt with it across many rounds. A thousand puppets therefore repeat one fable. Influence costs elapsed, attested history rather than tokens, so a sybil swarm must burn months of real labor to mimic a sparrow, while an honest comet of reputation keeps a tail nobody can borrow.
